content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: About Your First Payment Gateway Record ## slug: about-your-first-payment-gateway-record ## seoTitle: About Your First Payment Gateway Record ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Info) () Your first Payment Gateway record, named "primary", was created automatically during setup. ::: To view the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record, follow the steps below. 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} object. * Lightning/Classic: Payments (Admin) App > Payment Gateways Tab 2. Select “All” from the list of List Views. 3. Click the record named "primary." ![Primary Stripe Payment Gateway](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Primary%20Stripe%20Payment%20Gateway.png){height="" width=""} When the {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Default}} field is checked, any {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s created without a related {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} will automatically use the default {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. Only one {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} can be set as the default. The Gateway Information section provides the connection details. If these fields are blank, data in Salesforce will not process in the gateway. See [Step 8 in Create a Stripe Payment Gateway](/v1/docs/create-a-stripe-payment-gateway) to connect to your gateway. :::(Warning) (**Do not copy your Stripe API keys and insert them here.**) These keys are different from your Stripe keys which are OAuth keys. You can only get these keys by clicking the **Connect to Stripe** button. :::
procedures: 2. Select “All” from the list of List Views
